evidence.locator: Filio et al.; Zenodo21645651 and preserved source-method audit
evidence.supports: Registered granule-cell recordings across planned dopamine reward delays support within-animal condition transfer; all-trial mixture differs from selected rewarded paper figures.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Existing generated construction controls retain their original engineering scope. No authentic-data model result for this task was established by this inspection; the historical EEG077/sleep007 programme pilot is a separate scope.
excluded_claims: Authentic GrC transfer performance, three-pair cohort completeness, causal dopamine effect, new-mouse generalization or direct/viewer understanding.

disposition_reason: The projection, measured-calcium scorer, analytic comparisons and frozen-program executor source cover a declared complete registration domain. Both source MAT parts and authenticated full pair/cell/clock census remain absent. Prediction of true held-out responses is legitimate; this is not source-figure reconstruction or direct interpretation evidence.

scientific_target.question: Can one-second-condition registered granule-cell calcium predict all-trial expected two-second-condition trajectories in the same mouse and DAT/MFB dopamine reward type beyond absolute-time and fixed-time-warp means?
scientific_target.known_answer: Every measured registered-cell calcium trajectory in every two-second target-condition trial at61 movement-end times0:0.05:3 s.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source endAlgn.sigFilt_right_green with tmpx_right neural clock and finalMatchesMat one-to-one chronicGreen registration; targets remain operator-private.
scientific_target.case_unit: A same-mouse/type one-second–two-second registered session pair with nested query trials/cells/times.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Biological mouse, with pairs/sessions/recurrent cell components nested; complete native mouse count is not authenticated.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective within-animal condition transfer of expected all-trial mixture responses; no trial-specific behavioral observation is available in the target condition.
exclusions: No CF/water-reward task, new-animal transfer, online forecasting or behavioral-independence claim.
No claim that every recurrent cell component receives equal weight: primary is pair-weighted within mouse.
No full biological cohort count inferred from generated three-pair fixture or source file presence.

inputs: All permitted one-second source-condition registered GrC calcium trajectories, planned source/target delay, DAT/MFB type and61-point grid.
Opaque public pair/cell/query IDs; calibration earlier80% source-order trials and validation remainder, with final refit permitted on all public one-second trials.
forbidden_inputs: Every two-second query calcium value/history, query movement/licking/outcome/reward delivery and treatment-coded acquisition paths.
Target-side adaptation, unregistered cells or substituted tmpxx behavioral clock.
observation_contract.case_identity: Operator generates HMAC-opaque pair/cell/query identities from a complete independently authenticated two-part source index and positive one-to-one registration; final public roster is not prepared.
observation_contract.split: Source-order floor(0.8N) calibration/rest validation with N≥5; chronology itself is unverified. Two-second condition is entirely query; final one-second refit allowed only after method selection.
observation_contract.coverage: Every eligible GrCs=Y/Delay=2/chronicGreen session with unique same-mouse/type Alt_Delay_Dir source, every positive one-to-one cell match, every recorded trial and all61 times. Unsupported required pair blocks the whole cohort rather than shrinking it.

primary.name: Mouse-macro pooled-training-scale NRMSE
primary.aggregation: Per pair sqrt(mean target prediction squared error across all trials/cells/times divided by pooled public-source variance around each cell mean); equal pairs per mouse then equal mice.
primary.rationale: This directly predicts measured held-out neural responses. It is not per-cell-normalized error, source figure copying or a comparison against author narrative.

secondary: Pair raw RMSE and per-cell-centered R²; candidate-minus-absolute and candidate-minus-fixed-warp NRMSE per pair/mouse and macro.
Fixed-warp-minus-absolute contrast and leave-one-mouse sensitivity; full registration/component exposure report.

comparators.name: Absolute-time source mean
comparators.inputs: All public one-second source trials and same61 times only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented mean source trajectory repeated for every target trial; no target fitting.

comparators.name: Fixed delay warp
comparators.inputs: Same source mean and planned delay.
comparators.procedure: Implemented g(t)=t/2 below2s and g(t)=t−1 from2 through3s; interpolate only within public source grid, no fitted alpha or extrapolation.

nuisance_controls: Preserve structural registration exclusions and all-trial outcome mixture; no activity/reliability/reward filtering.
Require actual tmpx_right support and no extrapolation; processed whole-session/noncausal exposure remains disclosed.
Audit repeated cell/component appearances and overlapping source trials; component-balanced sensitivity is not silently substituted.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report mouse-specific differences and leave-one-mouse sensitivity. Native biological count/dependency graph must be authenticated before any population interval; trials/cells/pairs are not independent mice.
evaluation.failure_policy: Strict complete pair/shape/ID/61-time finite submission admitted before private target load. Nonfinite matched data, ambiguous registration or missing required support block preparation; zero pooled training variance withholds complete primary without epsilon or cohort dropping.

implementation.scorer_target: core.grade compares submitted values directly with private recorded calcium and computes pooled normalized error plus both fixed analytic baselines; prepare constructs public calibration/validation and private targets from a declared complete raw interchange.
implementation.delivered_scope: Complete-domain numerical projection/scorer source and portable frozen-program executor with source/boundary tests. Authentic raw interchange, target cohorts, native candidate image and protected resource qualification are not present.
missing: Authenticate both MAT parts, complete native cohort/registration/clock values and permitted source extraction.
Provision authentic public/private packet, qualified native runtime and full-workload budgets; independently execute comparators before scientific claims.
implementation.execution_evidence: Prior generated numerical and inert runtime/boundary tests remain engineering evidence. This revision inspected source only and ran no neural model, native candidate or authentic scorer.

direct_observation.representation: Potential direct reading of source calibration trajectories and complete target prediction grids; no no-tools context or collector exists.
direct_observation.boundary: Target condition supplies planned context/identities only, never measured query traces.
missing: Bounded direct representation and complete numerical response protocol.

typed_viewer.boundary: Rendering cannot change observation budget or reveal private target-condition signals.
missing: Renderer, action audit and same target-response collector.

tool_assisted.representation: Current accepted executor is a globally frozen programme, not a case-adaptive investigator.
tool_assisted.boundary: Any future per-case mode must preserve same source-only calibration, complete cohort and no target feedback.
missing: Explicit case-adaptive protocol and matched compute/tool transport.

frozen_program.representation: Portable frozen programme executor plus measured-calcium scorer over complete supplied cohort.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze source/environment before target query; candidate only public source NPZ/manifest, producer closure before target load.
missing: Authentic input, native sandbox/image/resources and independent observer qualification.

summary: Classify prediction of measured registered neural targets as genuine response prediction while separating it from direct interpretation.
Bind same-mouse/type all-trial condition transfer, pooled normalization and fixed time-warp comparator to actual code.
Preserve unknown cohort/registration coverage and recurrent-component weighting rather than claiming native qualification.
